_about: Limits perf/run.sh check enforces. Set 2026-09-26 from evals/results/2026-09-26-perf-baseline-0555-0caa10d with the budgetRule in config.json. Its first launch started at load 6.5 (limit 6.0) and gave the worst cold_launch (1,504 ms against a 920 ms median), which loosens that case's worst budget; its other sample was in line. Change only by a reviewed edit that says why. On 2026-09-27 the four long-chat cases (cold_first_open_replies, warm_return_replies, cold_no_snapshot_replies, cold_no_snapshot_tools) were tightened from evals/results/2026-09-27-perf-baseline-1919-c450c11 after PR #139 fixed the long markdown chat (warm return 4.9 s to 1.55 s median); the old limits would have let it regress unnoticed. The other cases keep their 2026-09-26 limits. The two no-snapshot cases now settle (about 5.5 s and 1.5 s) instead of landing by the 10 s cap, so they accept only a settled landing. On 2026-10-25 (PR 3, the Pi engine) the two cold_no_snapshot cases were removed: chat snapshots are gone, so the cases no longer exist. Every remaining case was measured on eve and is re-baselined on the Pi engine before the next release (rows_first_paint_ms and rows_done_ms are new). The per-case snapshot `sources` were dropped with the snapshots.
